summary: Found 5 qualified roofing contractor leads in Ashtabula County and surrounding Northeast Ohio region. All targets offer residential and commercial roofing services, with strong local presence and established reputations. The RoofQuote AI tool would provide immediate value through automated roof analysis, aerial measurement integration, and instant quoting capabilities—addressing a key efficiency gap in the traditional roofing sales process.

leads.name: A & R Roofing
leads.fit_rationale: Family-owned business operating in Ashtabula County since 1992. Provides roofing, gutter services, and snow plowing. Fully insured with local focus. The RoofQuote tool would streamline their free estimate process and modernize their customer acquisition.

leads.name: S&K Construction And Remodeling LLC
leads.fit_rationale: A+ BBB accredited, certified Owens Corning Preferred Contractor serving Ashtabula County and 310+ cities across Northeast Ohio. Offers 50-year warranties and specializes in one-day roof replacements. Strong digital presence indicates openness to technology adoption. RoofQuote would integrate well with their existing financing options and drone inspection services.

leads.name: Affordable Roofing and Construction LLC
leads.fit_rationale: BBB Accredited Business serving all of Ashtabula County including Conneaut, Geneva, and Madison. Located at 2829 Aberdeen Ave, Ashtabula. Name suggests price-conscious positioning that would align well with an instant quote tool that helps homeowners understand costs upfront.

leads.name: Runyon and Sons Roofing
leads.fit_rationale: Over 50 years of experience serving Lake, Geauga, Cuyahoga, and Ashtabula Counties from Mentor, OH. Specializes in shingle, flat, and metal roofs. Well-established regional player with multi-county service area. AI roof analysis would enhance their reputation as a modern, efficient contractor.

leads.name: Peet Roofing
leads.fit_rationale: Local Ashtabula roofing contractor located at 3325 Ridgewood Ave with all-star BBB rating. Fully insured and focused on Ashtabula community with services extending to surrounding areas. Smaller local operator who would benefit significantly from automated quoting to compete with larger regional players.

branding_quality_assessment.current_state: The RoofQuote MVP is currently unbranded and non-functional due to a missing Google Maps API key configuration. The page displays a raw technical error message ('Please configure VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY to use this app') which significantly damages credibility.
branding_quality_assessment.white_label_readiness: HIGH - The generic utility layout and neutral color palette make this highly adaptable for any roofing contractor. The core value proposition (AI roof analysis with instant quotes) is universally applicable across the roofing industry.

aesthetics_and_layout_notes: The layout follows standard SaaS landing page patterns with a centered hero section and clear CTA. The purple/gray color scheme is neutral but lacks personality. Once branded with contractor colors and logo, this would present as a professional tool. The input-focused design is appropriate for the quoting use case.

whitelabel_potential.reasoning: The RoofQuote tool has exceptional white-label potential. The AI roof analysis concept is industry-agnostic within roofing, and the simple address-input-to-quote flow can be skinned for any contractor. All 5 researched leads could benefit from this tool with minimal customization—primarily branding swap and service area configuration. The underlying technology (aerial imagery analysis, measurement extraction, material calculation) applies universally across residential roofing contractors.
whitelabel_potential.estimated_effort_to_deploy: Low - 2-4 hours per contractor for branding, content customization, and API configuration
